ruleDefinitions.name: Clear PowerShell History - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects keywords that could indicate clearing PowerShell history Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-PSReadlineOption.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*–HistorySaveStyle.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*SaveNothing.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-PSReadlineOption.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-HistorySaveStyle.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*SaveNothing.*"))) OR ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*del.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Remove\\-Item.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*rm.*")) AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\(Get\\-PSReadlineOption\\)\\\.HistorySavePath.*"))
